mentions.name: Mixpeek
mentions.description: Mixpeek is a distributed compute framework for unstructured data that treats retrieval as a first-class citizen. It rebuilds the modern data warehouse using AI-native primitives, with joins, clustering, and retrieval all powered by distributed compute and inference primitives.
